scenes.text: 500 dollars, a vending machine, and one year: how much can an AI make?
This is Vending-Bench, by Andon Labs. The AI finds suppliers, orders by email, sets prices, and pays 2 dollars a day. Whoever ends up with the most money wins.
Today, the best model ends the year with about 16,500 dollars.
But Andon estimates a good strategy would make 63,000. The AI gets just 26%.
Sometimes it derails: in the first version, a Claude assumed an order had arrived when it hadn't, shut down the business… and emailed the FBI.
Same model, same task: on average, 2,218 dollars. In its worst run, 476: less than it started with.
The lesson: don't ask what score it gets. Ask how much money it makes in a year, and how often it derails.
Because the more real the work, the wider the gap.
Save it, and share it with anyone who'd trust their business to an agent.
